no_leakage_statement: selector scores use only information strictly before cutoff (as-of features, frozen Group B predictions, Group C as-of structural features, Group D as-of IG); future labels are used ONLY for evaluation. Full-window static priors are flagged LEAKY and reported separately as baseline-tier only.

ig.source: groupD wallet_ig_20220901.csv, ig_occ aggregated by target+model (2,999 subset)

random.label: Random (seed=20220901)
random.note: uniform random scores, fixed seed 20220901 (single draw; expectation K*mean also reported in frontier as random_expected).

volume.label: Volume (evt_cnt_90d)
volume.note: 90-day primary-event count as transaction-volume proxy (Group A feature matrix).

volume_usd.label: Volume USD (native+token balance)
volume_usd.note: as-of USD-denominated capital proxy (native_usd+token_usd_priced) from Group A; balance-based, NOT flow. NaN (no priced row) => outside support.

eth_flow.label: ETH flow (evt_native_90d)
eth_flow.note: 90-day native-ETH transfer event count as ETH-flow proxy (Group A feature matrix).

recency.label: Recency (last_event_recency_days, inverted)
recency.note: more recent last event = higher score; score = 90 - last_event_recency_days (Group A feature matrix).

behavioral.label: Behavioral (cluster-internal volume rep)
behavioral.note: Group A persona (full_asof__kmeans); within each cluster take the percentile rank of evt_cnt_90d so each persona contributes its volume-representatives.

behavioral_act.label: Behavioral (cluster-internal activity rep)
behavioral_act.note: same as behavioral but representative = cluster-internal percentile of active_days_90d.

predictive_act.label: Predictive (future activity level)
predictive_act.note: Group B frozen LightGBM level prediction for future activity (pred_act_level_LightGBM); model trained 06-01 / tuned 07-01 / frozen-test 08-01, applied at 09-01.

predictive_new.label: Predictive (future new counterparties)
predictive_new.note: Group B frozen LightGBM level prediction for future new counterparties (pred_new_level_LightGBM).

hybrid_pred_vol.label: Hybrid predictive+volume
hybrid_pred_vol.note: rank-average of percentile ranks of pred_act_level and evt_cnt_90d.

degree.label: Degree (as-of undirected)
degree.note: as-of undirected degree on the matched-matched 7,929 subgraph built from events strictly before cutoff (Group C).

pagerank.label: PageRank (as-of)
pagerank.note: as-of PageRank on matched-matched subgraph (Group C).

betweenness.label: Betweenness (as-of)
betweenness.note: as-of betweenness (Group C); extended structural baseline.

bridge_score.label: Bridge score (as-of)
bridge_score.note: Group C community bridge score; extended structural baseline.

static_degree.label: Static degree (full-window prior, LEAKY)
static_degree.note: full-window static prior from ethereum_graph.gpickle; leaky prior baseline only (protocol: MUST NOT be used as as-of prediction feature). Reported separately.

static_pagerank.label: Static PageRank (full-window prior, LEAKY)
static_pagerank.note: full-window static PageRank prior; leaky prior baseline only.

ig_cp.label: Info gain (fwd cp>=10)
ig_cp.note: wallet-level occurrence information gain for target fwd30_cp_distinct>=10, HistGBM, averaged over folds (Group D).

ig_active.label: Info gain (fwd active)
ig_active.note: wallet-level occurrence IG for target fwd30_evt_cnt>0, HistGBM (Group D).

hybrid_pred_ig.label: Hybrid predictive+IG
hybrid_pred_ig.note: rank-average of percentile ranks of pred_act_level and ig_cp; restricted to the 2,999 IG subset.

oracle.label: Oracle future-label reference
oracle.note: upper-bound reference only; NOT a selector

compute.mode: local CPU, no LLM, no BigQuery
